review.name: Eclipse Kitsune
findings: Original independent brow, muzzle, lower chin, side jaw and ear samples detect the released facial defect. Complete-face binding, four fitted visible leg chains and coordinated standing actions preserve the sculpt, textures, original 21 bone frames and inverse binds, and unrelated authored head/neck/tail curves. All twelve candidate source slices and 216 actual equipped technique frames actually inspected and pass. Sole samples 102/99/109/115 retain support within 0.000107 over 481 times per action; front left lifts 0.04 during attack and other three support, cast/recoil keep all four planted. New sole isolation rejects cross-paw candidate v1. Separate rebuilt battle and final repeat review pending.

Final second pass actually inspected all 24 source/battle raw face/body slices, all 32 production transition slices at low/medium, 24 advancing companion idle frames, all 216 native actual equipped-technique frames in twelve lossless strips, and sixteen atlas cells. All pass. Source and battle each pass 485 full-geometry poses and 468 independent face blends. Original sculpt, UVs, textures, all original bone frames/inverses retained. Complete-face binding repair plus four fitted limb chains, five gait passes and three coordinated actions. Fourteen regression/animation-bank tests and production build pass. Whole-roster/main/live verification still pending.

companionTechniqueAudit.label: independent-mythic-000-anatomical-v1-final-techniques
companionTechniqueAudit.finding: All nine actual equipped techniques rechecked front and side. Complete muzzle, jaw and ears remain stable; neck, shoulder and hip joins stay connected and all nine tails remain continuous. Front left paw lifts through its fitted chain during strikes; the other three support. Cast and recoil retain all four support paws.

freshVisualFirstPass.label: independent-mythic-000-005-baseline-source
freshVisualFirstPass.finding: Face and long muzzle shear under secondary idle, recoil, victory and turned defeat. Four feet remain attached but front legs extend with body displacement rather than maintaining support through strikes, cast and recovery. Head/neck contribution independently measured on visible soles (peak 0.01904); lowest recoil sole drops 0.06175 from standing. Nine tails remain visually connected; preserve their sculpt and authored curves. Full source/battle final review required after repair.
